Supp Fig. 3F
progenitor_genes <- c("Axin2", "Sox9", "Cdh2", "Fut4", "Msi1", "Notch1", "Tert", "Aldh1a1", "Aldh1a3", "Abcg2", "En2",
                      "Gstm7", "Lef1", "Hmga1", "Tead2", "Lgr5")
DotPlot(Epi, features = progenitor_genes, col.min = 0, col.max = 2) + RotatedAxis() +
  guides(size = guide_legend(title = "% Exp."),  # Update size legend title
         color = guide_colorbar(title = "Avg. Exp.")) +  # Update color legend title
  scale_y_discrete(labels = function(x) sub("Epithelial cells-", "Epi", x)) +
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),  # Remove x-axis title
    axis.title.y = element_blank()   # Remove y-axis title
  )
